event_chain.summary: Publishing error exposed confidential voter records

summary: Following a software update on August 14, 2026, the Colorado Secretary of State's Office accidentally exposed online the records of 59 confidential voters - including public officials and people with safety concerns such as domestic violence survivors - with names, addresses, party affiliation and voting history. State officials found and fixed the exposure on August 25; at least some records were accessed.
